title: Why Zoning Is Too Restrictive
eligible_reason: Quantitative spatial model plus a cross-sectional CBSA-level OLS/IV analysis of regulation on municipal fragmentation (log HHI instrumented by historical 1875 fragmentation), Tables 1-3. The only DiD is the Toronto amalgamation case study (single event, MATLAB, appendix Tables A.11-A.12). No staggered adoption.
design_notes: MATLAB (model, Toronto) and R (fixest feols IV). CBSA analysis sample shipped; CoreLogic inputs proprietary.
data_files_note: README: all inputs public except CoreLogic tax assessor data (licensed).
data_provenance_note: Processed CBSA analysis sample and Toronto CMHC series shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from README files and analysis code. Cross-sectional IV; not a DiD paper.
